title: refresh.v1
description: The state of ONE `<cli> refresh` run (the STATE root ($<state_env>)/refresh/<run_id>.json, rewritten atomically): which bounded approval it uses, and how far its steps got. A rerun continues the latest running/failed one, skipping its done steps. Its approval is spent when it completes or stops for good (status complete / spent).

plan_hash.description: sha256 of the signed bounds (the bounded approval's plan_hash).

status.description: running: steps are executing. failed: a step failed and the run is resumable (same run id, same approval, inside its TTL; a site step's resume counts its ceiling again, so it fits only if the bounds leave that headroom). complete: every step done, the approval spent. spent: stopped for good (a bound breach, a challenge or cooldown stop, the approval expired or revoked, or --abandon).

id.description: position:name, e.g. 2:crawl-lists (crawl-lists may repeat); the step's identity for resume and done-tracking.

summary.description: The last JSON object the step printed on stdout.

reason.description: Why it failed (a paid gate's stop names the count and the flag).

paid_count.description: A paid-gated step: the count its --dry-run reported.

headroom.description: The bounded approval's headroom over this run's `used` lines (net of refunds).
